scope: One bounded preparation-only evaluation candidate; not production wiring, a new release baseline or execution authorization

config.tokenize: Unicode-aware camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case split; lowercase; len>=2
config.lexicalIndex: Separate symbol-name and comment/string-stripped source-body token fields; BM25 symbol-name score + bounded IDF-weighted distinct query-term coverage
config.graphExpansion: Callers, callees and type-hierarchy nodes reachable from each of the real top-50 symbol hits; one graph hop; bounded best lexical evidence per neighboring node
config.productionFilePriority: For implementation queries, ordinary test/spec/fixture paths rank after production files with positive evidence; explicit test queries are unchanged
config.rendering: Existing evaluation-only complete-symbol clustering with real per-file hit provenance and fixed global hard ceiling; no whole-method slicing, budget increase or uncapping

inputsPermitted: Real graph and source-body symbol index
acceptance: All five retained tasks must have index, candidate and rendered-source coverage, no hard-ceiling, strict C/S proof and deterministic C/C. Any missing required source or hard-ceiling triggers C; no parameter retry.
